summary: Walking onto a wished trap door stops at JS hero movement preflight. C runs trap.c trapeffect_hole() and fall_through(), opens the door, and schedules descent; the next C step reaches goto_level(). Port fall_through and admit the HOLE/TRAPDOOR hero path with the same level-transition contract.

source.branch: A grounded hero enters a square containing an unseen TRAPDOOR on a level where Can_fall_thru is true. dotrap() reaches trapeffect_hole(); fall_through(TRUE, flags) reveals the trap, emits the opening message, resolves fall prevention including an adjacent pet, computes the destination, and calls schedule_goto().
callers: trap.c dotrap() calls trapeffect_selector(), which sends TRAPDOOR to trapeffect_hole() and then fall_through(TRUE,...).

js/hack.js movement preflight calls js/trap_effects.js preflight_dotrap(), which currently rejects TRAPDOOR before dotrap() changes state; js/trap_effects.js trapeffect_hole() also refuses the hero fall_through() branch.
dependencies: Wire schedule_goto() and the ensuing do.c goto_level() transition, preserving pet movement and random-call order; the C recording reaches level generation after the trap door.

The parked trap.c monster magic-trap goal includes a historical fall_through declaration, but source completion for the hero trapdoor branch is not established; reconcile that goal before opening a replacement.
